Bug_Title: RANGE: Array length is out of bounds (RANGE_ARRAY_LENGTH)
Bug_Details: Method is called with array parameter and length parameter, but the length is out of bounds. This will result in IndexOutOfBoundsException at runtime.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded by attempting to access an index of an array that is out of bounds. The method showBug() takes an array and a length as input parameters, but it attempts to access arr[length], which would result in an IndexOutOfBoundsException if length is equal to or greater than the size of the array.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug() method calls BuggyArray.showBug() with an array of length 5 and a length parameter of 5. This triggers the bug because it attempts to access arr[5], which is out of bounds for the array, causing an IndexOutOfBoundsException.
